'''Charles Dexter Ward''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Neil's Curiosity Shop]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Lore]]
*+1 [[Speed]]

Increase your [[Combat check]] bonuses from [[Spell]]s by +1.

==Mythos Source==
Charles Dexter Ward appears in the novella ''The Case of Charles Dexter Ward'', written by H.P. Lovecraft (1927).
